name: rosetta-string-matching
code:
use default

let text = "the rain in spain stays mainly in the plain"

let wanted = "ain"

write_line("starts with the: {text.starts_with("the")}")
write_line("contains {wanted}: {text.contains(wanted)}")
write_line("ends with plain: {text.ends_with("plain")}")
write_line("first at: {text.index_of(wanted)}")

let places =
    (0..text.length - wanted.length + 1)
        |> filter(at => text[at..at + wanted.length] =~ wanted)
        |> map(at => "{at}")
        |> join(", ")

write_line("all at: {places}")

let wanted = "ain"

write_line("ends with plain: {text.ends_with("plain")}")
write_line("first at: {text.index_of(wanted)}")

let places =
    (0..text.length - wanted.length + 1)
